description: Books a personal shopping run: a BuyNearby driver shops the given item list at a named store and delivers it. Creates a real order; the customer is charged the driver's actual receipt total afterward. Item prices given are estimates.

estimated_price.description: CAD, your best estimate for this line - becomes the driver's shopping budget

store_hint.description: Physical store name, e.g. 'Purdys Chocolatier Chinook Centre'
